numerical_characteristics.magnitude: int64 bounds: results whose absolute value exceeds lib.i8max overflow the timedelta64[ns] range; Series([Timedelta(100000, 'days')]*2).sum() example overflows
category_specific_evidence: Mathematical property violated: a timedelta64 sum/product whose magnitude exceeds int64 bounds (lib.i8max) must raise OutOfBoundsTimedelta rather than silently saturate to i8max; the guard checks np.abs(result) > lib.i8max on the ndarray branch of _wrap_results
